sampling_definitions.cpu: Cgroup cpu.stat usage_usec delta /1e6 = core-seconds; per-window divide by monotonic seconds for average cores; record throttling and host/process scopes separately.
sampling_definitions.memory: Cgroup memory.current/peak, process RSS/working set and allocator high-water; include sampling interval and missed transient peaks, all replicas and queue copies.
sampling_definitions.database: Scoped query calls/time/rows/scans/plan hash, active/pool/lock waits and commits. No global statistics reset. WAL attribution requires isolated DB or explain confounders; global WAL under foreign writes is not candidate-only cost.
sampling_definitions.io_network: Cgroup io.stat read/write bytes/ops plus device latency, DB WAL and transport bytes/compression. Container counters are not a host disk-latency measurement.
sampling_definitions.latency: Separate trading/admission, SDK->writer->Redis, producer->Research durable commit and Portal API/fanout exposures. Source event time is not observation age.
sampling_definitions.recovery: High-water events/bytes/oldest age; peak and sustained replay rate minus producer rate; durable cursor/retention floor, outage runway and same final digest.
sampling_definitions.normalized_cost: Per committed unique record/byte and per new dashboard; preserve full numerator, denominator, population and unit. Near-zero baselines use approved absolute thresholds only.

budget_note: Every group is UNDECIDED. Expand composite named counters into distinct scalar rows with approved units/window/soft-high-hard values before execution; no scalar placeholder authorizes a vector or creates unlimited headroom.

sizing.memory_formula: sum(replicas * (queues + inflight_copies + decompressed + cache + pool_tasks + runtime + allocator_reserve)); include TS/transport/Research/DB and host reserves separately without double-counting shared cgroups
